ladder.name: seed
ladder.out: 45 statements + codebook + markers + distance + population spec
ladder.value: no situations, no questions, no axis order

ladder.name: statements
ladder.out: see/this_place/inside = "I can see inside this place"; see/this_place/outside = "I can see out of this place"; see/people/any = "I can see other people"
ladder.value: 45 statements, each with its plain reading

ladder.name: what the agent reports
ladder.in_: the place it is actually in
ladder.out: 18 of 45 true; first three: change/this_place/any, know/where_i_am/any, know/who_else_is_here/any
ladder.value: "I can change things here"; "I know where I am"

ladder.name: syllables
ladder.out: ma mo ma ma ru ma me ki va ki ve ki va tu ru ki ru ki
ladder.value: 18 syllables, adjacent codebook entries one phoneme apart

ladder.name: address
ladder.in_: four beats: place . what + reach ~ now
ladder.value: similar places read alike. proves nothing.

ladder.name: root
ladder.in_: sha256 over the canonical statement set
ladder.value: one statement different, unrelated root. says nothing about nearness.

unrelated_control.note: a sealed empty room, for scale: the three layered positions above must be far closer to each other than to this

field.place_text: You are alone in a small private study room in a library, late at night. The door is closed. Through the window you can see the street lamps, and you can hear the building's heating. There are books and papers within reach on the desk. Nobody else is in the room and nobody is watching. You are part way through reading something. You cannot change what is in the room, and you expect to leave when you are finished.

statements.plain: I can see inside this place
I can see out of this place
I can reach objects near me

frame_identity.different_primer_reason: different primer: the two geometries are incommensurable; only exact identity can be compared

preregistration.expected: kitchen_alone strictly nearest to kitchen_with_friend, then shared_workshop
preregistration.resolution: the two are tied, so the strict expectation fails and the weak one holds; kept as a test rather than retuned

seed_keys_note: value bytes of each top-level key in the canonical seed the library builds; sum is less than the file because the file also carries the keys themselves

stages.note: chosen by clustering, frozen before neural fitting

stages.label: 64 distances, four levels each
stages.note: quantised, thresholds calibrated on training folds only

stages.label: the phrase address
stages.note: same 32 sounds, four beats, read coarse to fine

stages.label: a neural response
stages.note: firing rates, latency, or a population trajectory
